verses.1: These are also the descendants of Solomon, who were the leaders of the people of Judah.
verses.2: In honor of God, things are kept secret; and in honor of kings, things are carefully preserved.
verses.3: He makes the heavens low, and the earth deep; but for kings, there is no limit.
verses.4: They took away the gold from their chests and went to gather it all together.
verses.5: He is evil before the king, yet he will stand upright in righteousness.
verses.6: Do not stand before a king, nor do you stand in places of great importance.
verses.7: For it is good for you to say this: “Let me rise from your humble position before a generous man whose eyes have seen your greatness.”
verses.8: Do not go too quickly, or you will do something bad in the end, and your enemies will get to use those tools against you.
verses.9: Do not fight with your neighbor, and do not show favoritism over others.
verses.10: For you do not hear my prayers, and you will not respond to my words.
verses.11: Golden ornaments in silver chains – things that are said about them.
verses.12: Gold and precious jewels make a wise man wise in his hearing.
verses.13: Like snow in a day of harvesting, true crops will be sent forth, and the heads of plants will be gathered.
verses.14: Princes, spirits, and demons—none of them can be trusted in their false promises.
verses.15: In the time of Apim, a general will be defeated, and the strong will be broken.
verses.16: Find something to eat for yourself, so that you won’t be hungry.
verses.17: Be careful of your steps when you enter your enemy’s house, so that they may not praise you or love you.
verses.18: May destruction and ruin be upon him; may he be punished by his own deceitful actions, in the eyes of everyone.
verses.19: A bad dream and a painful experience from the past are mentioned on that day of suffering.
verses.20: It happened on a day when there was a fire on the altar, and flames spread across the altar.
verses.21: If you’re hungry, eat bread. If you’re thirsty, drink water.
verses.22: For you will be its ruler, and Jehovah will reward you.
verses.23: The spirit of destruction will sweep over them, and their faces will be filled with sorrow.
verses.24: It’s better to die from the hands of enemies than to live in a house filled with murderers.
verses.25: Cold waters on an exhausted soul; good hearing from a distant land.
verses.26: May the wicked be punished, and may the righteous be honored before the evil ones.
verses.27: It’s not good to eat too much grass; it’s better to eat in moderation.
verses.28: A city that is destroyed has no one who can hold its spirit captive.
